messages.text: Immediate presence of adv aswad attar is required in court

Swearing-In Ceremony of Hon’ble Dr. Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati as Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh will be held on 09.09.2026 at 11:00 AM physically at Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology (SKUAST) and virtually in Hon’ble Chief Justice Court, Jammu Wing. Live on Official YouTube Channel of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
